description: Maps a repository (or a workspace path for non-repo folders) to the ACS billing project code used on invoices. Edit this file by hand; copilot-credit-rollup.py reads it and stamps billing_code onto every repository grouping in the generated summary. An entry with a null billing_code is known but not yet assigned a code.
matching: repo_name is matched first, then workspace_path. Unmatched records are reported under unmapped_repositories in the summary.
